# Bid the squares and the waste, not the house.

> Price a vinyl, fiber-cement, or engineered-wood siding job from wall area, waste, openings, stories, and tear-off — not a flat price per square foot. See labor hours, walk-away price, and the margin a neighborhood special actually leaves.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
